items.text: the founding testers are the Current founders club now, everywhere: the cover, the index, the Beat and Color notes, the founding pack
the cover's sign-up reads Play the field, with Join the Current founders club under it
Batch export's badge says Pro, not artist, like every other Pro feature

your first path discovery: turning the sound on (the speaker "start here" points at) is now step one of Path 01, and the first step you ever tick opens a card that says what paths are and where they lead
an open strip points down to its button with a notch in its own outline; the caret no longer peeks out behind it
the founding pack: the first 500 founding testers get 10 beats, 10 looks on 10 new G-code paths and 10 bytebeats, in the app and as a download
on desktop and iPad the popovers float: drag one by its grip, let go near an edge and it snaps there, pin it to keep it open while you play; double-tap the grip to send it home
pop out: the index moves into its own window beside the stage (desktop); the duck-rabbit brings it back
manual: print the index as a manual, or save it as a PDF, with a cover, contents and every section opened out
cards with the QR code leave out the small duck-rabbit in the lower right, so the code stands alone in that corner
add: Beat: eleven starter beats to load into the grid, from boom bap and dembow to son clave and a Euclidean rhythm
cards can carry the QR code again, as a choice: no code (the default) or QR code, beside branding. The code opens the exact look; its tile is the namemark's width
